svg.title: Human-led agentic research workflow
svg.desc: The human researcher sets goals, judges claims, and writes the manuscript. Three aligned columns connect research planner to adversarial critic, literature scout to simulation engineer, and theory assistant to reproducibility. All three feed the weekly output, which returns to the human for review and the next planning cycle. Connections follow the supplied figure.
svg.text: Sets goals • Accepts or rejects claims • Writes the manuscript
Claim decisions · Validated code and results · Updated priorities · Audit log
Reviewed by the researcher before the next planning cycle.
